card.name: Feeling fortunate to get a chance
card.fires_on: Words in phrases where the writer says they are lucky, proud, thrilled or pleased to do something, such as 'to' after 'fortunate' or 'pleasure' in 'had the pleasure of'. It is found in general web text about opportunities.

modes.label: to after happy adjective
modes.description: The word 'to' right after fortunate, proud, thrilled, lucky enough or love.
modes.example: We are so proud<< to>> welcome a new addition to the Upl

modes.label: Chance nouns
modes.description: Nouns like pleasure or opportunity in 'had the pleasure/opportunity (of/to)'.
modes.example: we are excited to have had the<< opportunity>> to work with them in this effort

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning opportunity, chance or being able to, such as 'opportunity', '机会' and '能够'.
card.plain: It marks phrases where someone says they are glad or lucky to get the chance to do something.
